travel.headline: Check Day Tickets and Attraction Access Before Visiting
travel.reservation: Check the operator’s current Day Ticket terms and opening arrangements for the show caves and museum. Jacob’s Ladder and the Lookout Tower are not suitable for wheelchair users or visitors with limited mobility. Beyond the View is described as wheelchair-friendly; verify availability before departure.

intel.title: Metered Conservation Parking
intel.text: The operator homepage recommends arriving before 11 AM during school and bank holidays to improve the chance of parking. Verify current charges and arrangements; space is not guaranteed.

intel.title: Village Connectivity
intel.text: The reviewed official sources do not establish mobile coverage at these stops. Save directions before departure rather than assuming reception.

intel.title: Regional Services
intel.text: The reviewed official sources do not establish fuel-station locations or operating hours. Check your refuelling options independently before departure.

intel.title: Summer Tower Hours
intel.text: In the summer months, the Lookout Tower closes at 4:30 PM. Plan your ascent early in the day to ensure you reach the top before closure.

intel.title: Wheelchair Accessibility
intel.text: Beyond the View is a fully accessible, wheelchair-friendly experience. However, Jacob’s Ladder and the Lookout Tower are not suitable for those with limited mobility.

plan.arrival: Check your Day Ticket and attraction opening arrangements with the operator before travelling. Confirm parking and accessibility separately rather than assuming admission or suitable access at every stop.
plan.vehicle: The reviewed sources do not establish rental or motorhome suitability on every approach road. Check your provider, the actual roads and each site’s vehicle restrictions before departure.
plan.goldenHour: For a suggested late-day visit at Gough’s cave, check daylight, closing times and current access first. A sunset view or after-hours admission is not established by these sources.
